title: umsf-incident-ai-agent: evidence-aware AI decision-support agent for rescue and consequence-liquidation logistics

creators.name: Beketova, Gulzhanat
creators.affiliation: Almaty University of Energy and Communications

description:
Research software implementing the decision-support layer of Evidence-Aware Multisensor Monitoring for Critical Infrastructure Incident Support (Torstensson et al., 2026). An AI agent ingests a multisensor incident dataset (personnel wearables, stationary building-state nodes, gateway, operator, responder and authoritative external reports), assesses it with coverage-aware physiological rules (Eq. 1-5) and a source-qualified zone incident state S_z = (M, H, P, F, U) (Eq. 6-7), and plans two logistics tracks: rescue logistics (personnel accounting and exact lexicographic team-task assignment, Eq. 8-9) and consequence-liquidation logistics (exact service-continuity allocation, Eq. 10-11, and a resource-constrained recovery schedule with hard prerequisites).

All arithmetic, eligibility, alerts and plans are deterministic. Every output is a proposal for the authorising role of Table 9 (rescue coordinator, incident coordination team, qualified assessor, infrastructure operator, recovery management) and is recorded with approvals/rejections and reasons in a hash-chained audit log. An optional Claude language-model layer only summarises minimised read-only aggregates and falls back to a deterministic Ukrainian briefing. The software does not diagnose, issue triage categories, select building entry routes or actuate equipment. It reproduces Table 10 and Section 4.9 / Table 16 / Fig. 14 of the paper exactly and ships a synthetic two-site post-impact scenario. It has not been validated against real rescue operations; coefficients are policy values, not survival probabilities.

Програмний проєкт обробки даних агентом штучного інтелекту з прийняттям рішень згідно з отриманими даними: логістика рятування людей і логістика ліквідації наслідків удару.
notes: Python >= 3.10; core uses the standard library only; optional dependency: anthropic. All shipped data are synthetic.
